  html_document: default

```{r}
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

cat("SO SANH FAMD vs NLPCA\n")
cat("======================\n\n")

# Tai len du lieu
# Thêm vào đầu chunk
load("nlpca_data.RData")  # hoặc
nlpca_data <- readRDS("nlpca_data.rds")

cat("Block 1: Kiem tra du lieu\n")
cat("Du lieu nlpca_data:\n")
cat("So dong:", nrow(nlpca_data), "\n")
cat("So cot:", ncol(nlpca_data), "\n")
cat("Loai bien:\n")
str(nlpca_data)
cat("\n")

cat("Block 2: Trién khai FAMD\n")
set.seed(123)
famd_result <- FAMD(nlpca_data,ncp = Inf, graph = FALSE)
cat("FAMD hoan thanh\n\n")

cat("Block 3: Tinh phuong sai giai thich\n")
famd_eig <- famd_result$eig

cat("So thanh phan FAMD tao ra:", nrow(famd_eig), "\n\n")
cat("TOAN BO CAC THANH PHAN:\n")
print(famd_eig)
cat("\n")

n_comp <- min(10, nrow(famd_eig))
famd_variance <- famd_eig[1:n_comp, 2]
famd_cumvar <- famd_eig[1:n_comp, 3]

cat(sprintf("Phuong sai giai thich (%d thanh phan dau):\n", n_comp))
cat("------------------------------------------\n")
for(i in 1:n_comp) {
  cat(sprintf("Dim%d:  %5.1f%%  (Tich luy: %5.1f%%)\n", 
              i, famd_variance[i], famd_cumvar[i]))
}
cat("------------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf("Tong %d thanh phan: %.1f%%\n\n", n_comp, famd_cumvar[n_comp]))

cat("Block 4: So sanh FAMD vs NLPCA\n")
nlpca_variance_manual <- c(23.4, 7.6, 6.9, 5.2, 4.3, 4.0, 3.9, 3.8, 3.6, 3.6)
nlpca_cumvar_manual <- c(23.4, 31.0, 37.8, 43.0, 47.3, 51.3, 55.2, 59.0, 62.6, 66.2)

if(n_comp < 10) {
  cat("CANH BAO: FAMD chi tao", n_comp, "thanh phan, mo rong NLPCA xuong", n_comp, "thanh phan\n")
  nlpca_variance_manual <- nlpca_variance_manual[1:n_comp]
  nlpca_cumvar_manual <- nlpca_cumvar_manual[1:n_comp]
}

comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Component = 1:n_comp,
  FAMD_Indiv = round(famd_variance, 1),
  FAMD_Cum = round(famd_cumvar, 1),
  NLPCA_Indiv = nlpca_variance_manual,
  NLPCA_Cum = nlpca_cumvar_manual,
  Difference = round(nlpca_cumvar_manual - famd_cumvar, 1)
)

print(comparison_table)
cat("\n")

cat("Block 5: Scree plot so sanh\n")
scree_data <- data.frame(
  Component = rep(1:n_comp, 2),
  Variance = c(famd_variance, nlpca_variance_manual),
  Method = rep(c("FAMD", "NLPCA"), each = n_comp)
)

p_scree <- ggplot(scree_data, aes(x = Component, y = Variance, 
                                  color = Method, group = Method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", Variance)), 
            vjust = -0.8, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FAMD" = "#2E7D32", "NLPCA" = "#E24A4A")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:n_comp) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot - FAMD vs NLPCA",
       x = "Thanh phan", 
       y = "Phuong sai (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("famd_nlpca_scree_comparison.png", p_scree, 
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Da luu: famd_nlpca_scree_comparison.png\n\n")

cat("Block 6: Cumulative variance so sanh\n")
cumvar_data <- data.frame(
  Component = rep(1:n_comp, 2),
  Cumulative = c(famd_cumvar, nlpca_cumvar_manual),
  Method = rep(c("FAMD", "NLPCA"), each = n_comp)
)

p_cumvar <- ggplot(cumvar_data, aes(x = Component, y = Cumulative, 
                                    fill = Method)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(60, 70, 80), linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", Cumulative)), 
            position = position_dodge(0.7), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FAMD" = "#2E7D32", "NLPCA" = "#E24A4A")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:n_comp) +
  labs(title = "Phuong sai tich luy - FAMD vs NLPCA",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d thanh phan: FAMD = %.1f%%, NLPCA = %.1f%%",
                          n_comp, famd_cumvar[n_comp], nlpca_cumvar_manual[n_comp]),
       x = "So thanh phan", 
       y = "Phuong sai tich luy (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("famd_nlpca_cumvar_comparison.png", p_cumvar, 
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Da luu: famd_nlpca_cumvar_comparison.png\n\n")

cat("Block 7: FAMD biplot\n")
p_famd_biplot <- fviz_famd_ind(famd_result, 
                                repel = TRUE,
                                col.ind = "#2E7D32",
                                alpha.ind = 0.3,
                                title = "FAMD Biplot") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("famd_biplot.png", p_famd_biplot, 
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("Da luu: famd_biplot.png\n\n")

cat("Block 8: Luu ket qua\n")
famd_summary <- list(
  famd_result = famd_result,
  variance = famd_variance,
  cumvar = famd_cumvar,
  variance_n = famd_cumvar[n_comp],
  n_components = n_comp,
  n_vars = ncol(nlpca_data),
  n_obs = nrow(nlpca_data),
  comparison_table = comparison_table
)

save(famd_summary, file = "famd_result.RData")
cat("Da luu: famd_result.RData\n\n")

cat("========================================\n")
cat("TONG KET SO SANH\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat(sprintf("So thanh phan: %d\n", n_comp))
cat(sprintf("FAMD  (26 bien): %.1f%% variance\n", famd_summary$variance_n))
cat(sprintf("NLPCA (26 bien): %.1f%% variance\n", nlpca_cumvar_manual[n_comp]))
cat(sprintf("Chenh lech:      %+.1f%%\n", 
            nlpca_cumvar_manual[n_comp] - famd_summary$variance_n))
cat("========================================\n")
```
